profile.headline:
Software Engineer | React | TypeScript | JavaScript | Node | 
Python | Postgres
profile.summary: Devoted software engineer focused on building intuitive applications through clean, maintainable code, while consistently advocating for a superior user experience. I have been problem solving for over a decade and have leveraged my mathematics education to design software using an analytical and methodical approach. I thoroughly enjoy learning new skills, teaching those skills to others, and seeing the world play with my creations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the front-end development of MyFriendBen, an application which enabled over 22,000 families to discover and unlock over $700,000,000 in financial support from government and non-profit programs.
- Onboarded and trained 4 engineers by creating training materials for the codebase which enabled them to build state-specific versions of the MyFriendBen platform.
- Led the development of a unified preschool application pilot, further extending the MyFriendBen platform's capabilities and providing comprehensive benefits access to a broader audience.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Managed all commercial projects for Las Vegas and Boulder City that required new or upgraded gas services.
- Led the planning and coordination of internal and external teams to design, troubleshoot, and construct a 30-million-dollar public infrastructure project.
- Created, managed, and executed gas service contracts worth up to 300,000 dollars.
positions.insights: Risk Management, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) and +3 skills

projects.title: MyFriendBen
projects.description: MyFriendBen empowers individuals and organizations to quickly and easily understand and access government benefits, tax credits, and nonprofit programs. Users answer a set of basic demographic questions about their household and receive a personalized report that shows eligibility, dollar value, and time required to apply for federal, state and local programs.
